Rashi on Sotah 47a:10:1.hebrew: אבן שואבת - שמגבהת את המתכת מן הארץ ומעמידתו באויר, [וע"י אותו אבן העמיד העגלים של ירבעם באויר]:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:10:1.english: A magnetic stone - [One] that lifts metal from the ground and suspends it in the air [and by means of that stone he suspended Jeroboam's calves in the air].

Rashi on Sotah 47a:11:1.hebrew: רבנן דחה - דוחה היה את התלמידים מפני אלישע כשהיה משמש לפניו, דכתיב לאחר שפירש ממנו: "המקום אשר אנחנו יושבין" — בית המדרש של רבנן — "צר ממנו", שנתוספו התלמידים שהיה גחזי דוחה:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:11:1.english: He pushed away the Sages - He used to push away the students from before Elisha when he was serving before him, as it is written after he separated from him: "The place where we sit" — [referring to] the study hall of the Sages — "is too cramped for us," for the students whom Gehazi had been pushing away increased [in number].

Rashi on Sotah 47a:12:1.english: King Yannai killed the Sages - As we say in Kiddushin, in [the chapter] HaOmer LiShlucho (66a).

Rashi on Sotah 47a:12:2.hebrew: בעלי שרוי בתוכך - נשיא (היה), כדאמרינן בחגיגה (דף טז:):
Rashi on Sotah 47a:12:2.english: My husband dwells within you - [He] was the Nasi, as we say in Chagigah (16b).

Rashi on Sotah 47a:13:1.english: [She] stood before them well - [She] honored him.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:13:2.english: This inn is beautiful - In its deeds.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:13:4.english: Is this what you are engaged in - Looking at a married woman.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:14:1.english: He signaled to him with his hand - [Indicating] that he would accept him.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:15:1.hebrew: יצר - של תשמיש, תקרבנו בימין שלא יקוץ בפריה ורביה. וכן תינוק, פן יברח ויאבד את עצמו. ואשה, אף היא דעתה קלה, ואם ירדפוה תצא לתרבות רעה:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:15:1.english: Inclination - [The inclination] for marital relations: draw it near with the right [hand], so that one does not come to loathe procreation. And similarly [with] a child, lest he flee and destroy himself. And [with] a woman, she too is light-minded, and if they drive her away, she will go out to evil ways.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:16:1.hebrew: תצא ותרעה בעדר - כשאר חולין. והאי תנא לית ליה הא דאמרינן בכמה דוכתי: עגלה ערופה נאסרה מחיים, וירידתה לנחל איתן אוסרתה. ובמסכת כריתות מוקמינן לה למילתא בפלוגתא דתנאי בפרק בתרא (דף כה.):
Rashi on Sotah 47a:16:1.english: It shall go out and graze among the herd - Like other non-sacred [animals]. And this Tanna does not hold of that which we say in several places: a heifer whose neck is broken becomes forbidden while [still] alive, and its descent to the rugged valley renders it forbidden. And in Tractate Keritot we establish this matter as a dispute of Tannaim, in the last chapter (25a).

Rashi on Sotah 47a:16:2.hebrew: כיפרה ספיקה - היא עשתה את שלה, ואם לא נמצא ההורג נתכפר הספק, ולכשנמצא נעשה ודאי ויהרג. ומיהו היא באיסור הנאה דידה קיימא, דכפרה כתיב בה כקדשים:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:16:2.english: It atoned [for] its uncertainty - It did its part, and if the killer had not been found, the uncertainty was atoned for, and when he is found, it becomes a certainty and he is killed. However, it remains in its prohibition of benefit, for "atonement" is written regarding it, like consecrated offerings.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:17:1.hebrew: שנים אומרים ראינו לא היו עורפין - דהא נודע מי הכהו, ואע"פ שאינו עכשיו בפנינו לדונו:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:17:1.english: [If] two say, "We saw," they would not break [the heifer's] neck - For it is known who struck him, even though he is not now before us to judge him.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:18:1.english: The heifer whose neck is broken was nullified - For they recognize among them who is accustomed among them to kill.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:19:1.hebrew: לא אפקוד - על ניאוף נשותיכם לבודקן. ומפני מה? על בנותיכם כי תזנינה, ועוד: כי הם עם הזונות יפרדו — הם עצמן נואפין כפרדים הללו:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:19:1.english: I will not punish - [for] the adultery of your wives, to test them. And why? [On account of] "your daughters when they commit harlotry," and furthermore, "for they themselves consort [yefaredu] with lewd women" — they themselves commit adultery like these mules [peradim].

Rashi on Sotah 47a:1:1.hebrew: ליהוו דובים ולא ליהוו יער - מאי עבד ליה יער, דקרית ליה נס:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:1:1.english: Let there be bears and let there not be a forest - What [purpose] did the forest serve for it, that you call it a miracle?

Rashi on Sotah 47a:1:2.hebrew: דבעיתי - הדובים להתגרות בהם כשאין מקום קרוב להם לנוס ולהתחבאות, וכשהן קרובים ליער, יוצאין בהבטחה:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:1:2.english: As they are frightened - The bears [are afraid] to attack them when there is no nearby place for them to flee and hide, and when they are near a forest, they come out with confidence.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:20:1.hebrew: האשכולות - מפרש בגמרא שהכל בהן. עד ימיהן לא היה מחלוקת בחכמי ישראל, כולן היו אומרים דברים כנתינתן למשה מסיני, והן הראשונים שנחלקו בסמיכת קרבנות ביום טוב, כדאמרינן בחגיגה (דף טז.), והוא היה מחלוקת ראשון שהיה בישראל בדברי תורה:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:20:1.english: The clusters - [The Gemara] explains [that it means those] in whom everything is [found]. Until their days, there was no dispute among the Sages of Israel; all of them would state matters as they were given to Moses from Sinai. And they were the first who disagreed regarding the laying of hands [semikhah] on offerings on a Festival, as we say in Chagigah (16a), and that was the first dispute that occurred in Israel regarding words of Torah.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:20:2.hebrew: העביר הודיית המעשר - שלא יהיו מתוודין "בערתי הקדש" כו', ובגמרא מפרש טעמא:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:20:2.english: Took away the declaration of the tithe - That they should not make the confession, "I have removed the sacred [produce]," etc., and in the Gemara [it] explains the reason.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:20:3.english: Awakeners and strikers - In the Gemara, [it] explains the reason.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:3:1.hebrew: זכה ויצתה ממנו רות - שיצאו ממנה דוד ושלמה שהרבו להקריב קרבנות, אלמא זה היה שכרו:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:3:1.english: He merited that Ruth descended from him - For David and Solomon, who offered many sacrifices, descended from her; thus, this was his reward.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:3:2.hebrew: לקללה הוה - למעט את ישראל, ואותה כוונה כאן נתקיימה:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:3:2.english: Was for a curse - To diminish Israel, and that intention was fulfilled here.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:4:1.hebrew: ואלא מאי טיבותיה - דמקום, הואיל והמים רעים והארץ משכלת:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:4:1.english: And rather, what is its goodness - Of the place, since the water is bad and the land miscarries?

Rashi on Sotah 47a:4:2.english: The grace of a place [is] upon its inhabitants - And even if it is bad, it appears good to them.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:4:3.hebrew: חן האשה - תמיד על בעלה, ואפי' היא מכוערת, נושאת חן בעיניו:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:4:3.english: The grace of a woman - [is] always upon her husband, and even if she is unattractive, she finds favor in his eyes.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:5:1.english: One [was] for inciting bears - [As a punishment] for the sin that he incited bears against the children.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:5:2.hebrew: חלה - חד, את חליו תרי, וחד אשר ימות בו:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:5:2.english: Became sick - [that is] one [illness]; "with his illness" [is] two; and one [more is] "from which he would die."

Rashi on Sotah 47a:8:1.hebrew: מי שקיל כולי האי - בהאי קרא כתיב שמנה דברים: כסף, ובגדים, וצאן, ובקר, ועבדים, ושפחות, וזיתים, וכרמים:
Rashi on Sotah 47a:8:1.english: Did he take all that - In this verse, eight things are written: silver, garments, sheep, cattle, manservants, maidservants, olive trees, and vineyards.

Rashi on Sotah 47a:8:2.english: [It was] silver and garments [that] he took - As it is written: "And he bound two talents of silver in two bags, and two changes of garments" (II Kings 5:23).

Rashi on Sotah 47a:8:3.english: In [the] eight creeping animals - In the chapter [entitled] Shemonah Sheratzim (Shabbat 107a).

Rashi on Sotah 47a:8:4.english: It is time to receive the reward - [for] your Torah [study] in this world.
